selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Why does the note say some ideas from other books were written again in this treatise?
questions.answer: Because those other parts were not there, so some important points were included again.

questions.question: What does the note say about this repetition?
questions.answer: It may look like repetition.

questions.question: What did they hope the students would end up with by writing it all?
questions.answer: A small but complete Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What was surprising about that person?
questions.answer: He did not know much about those matters, but something special still appeared in his copy.

questions.question: Why is it interesting that this person made the special pattern?
questions.answer: Because he did not know about such things.

questions.question: What careful detail was noticed in the copy?
questions.answer: The first letters of the lines showed a meaningful count.

questions.question: What title matched that number in abjad value?
questions.answer: Ayat al-Kubra, or The Supreme Sign.

questions.question: What did the matching number show about the title and the book?
questions.answer: It showed the title suited the book.

questions.question: Where were the other parts of the Risale-i Nur missing from?
questions.answer: From the place where this treatise was written.

questions.question: Because of that, what happened in The Supreme Sign?
questions.answer: Important points from other books were mentioned there too.

questions.question: What was the goal for the students in that region?
questions.answer: To write a miniature full Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What kind of copy was later revised?
questions.answer: A rough first draft.

questions.question: What kind of draft is mentioned before the revised copy?
questions.answer: A rough draft.

questions.question: At what place in the lines were the alifs counted?
questions.answer: At the starts of the lines.

questions.question: Where were the counted alifs found?
questions.answer: At the beginning of the lines.

questions.question: What two facts are given about alif in the footnote?
questions.answer: It is the first Arabic letter, and its number value is one.

questions.question: What second sign did they understand from the same number?
questions.answer: That the treatise was a flash from the light of Qur’an verses.

questions.question: What problem came from the other parts not being available?
questions.answer: Some important teachings had to be repeated in this treatise.

questions.question: What does the note call that repetition?
questions.answer: Something that appears to be repetition.

questions.question: Who wrote the corrected copy of the rough draft?
questions.answer: A blessed person.

questions.question: What kind of person made that revised copy?
questions.answer: A blessed person.

questions.question: Did he make the pattern on purpose because he knew the subject well?
questions.answer: No, he did not know such matters.

questions.question: What is an alif?
questions.answer: The first letter of the Arabic alphabet.

questions.question: How many alifs were counted at the beginnings of the lines?
questions.answer: Six hundred and sixty-six.
